$comment: Editors that use ncdev lsp: how far each is tested. One source for README.md's table (node scripts/readme-blocks.mjs) and the tools page's editor tiles with their Tested/Untested tags (the workbench build: <!--ED_TILES-->; tile: the tile's name, its short line, the README anchor it links to; its icon is start/editors/<id>.svg). Their setups are in PORTING.md. people/ai: what was tested, or null. page: the tools page's setup steps for the editor (<!--ED_STEPS-->): its heading and the steps, with `code`, **bold**, [links](…), {repo} for this repository and {snippet:<language>} for the editor's first code block in PORTING.md.

editors.name: Neovim
editors.ai: Neovim 0.9 (the 0.11 config is from its docs)

page.title: Neovim 0.11+
steps: Open a handler: problems show within a second. Older Neovim: [the setup for it]({repo}#neovim).

page.title: Helix
steps: Open a handler (`:lsp-restart` if Helix was already open).

page.title: Emacs 29+ (eglot)
steps: Open a handler and run <kbd>M-x eglot</kbd>.

editors.name: Kate
editors.setup: one entry in LSP Client settings ([PORTING.md](PORTING.md#kate-settings--configure-kate--lsp-client--user-server-settings))

page.title: Kate
steps: **Settings › Configure Kate › LSP Client › User Server Settings**, add:{snippet:json}
Open a handler. (Kate runs one server per language: this one takes over `.js` files.)

editors.name: JetBrains IDEs
editors.setup: the [LSP4IJ](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/23257-lsp4ij) plugin, a server added in Settings ([PORTING.md](PORTING.md#jetbrains-ides-lsp4ij))

page.title: JetBrains IDEs
steps: **Settings › Languages & Frameworks › Language Servers › +**: name `Nucleus`, command `ncdev lsp`, and under Mappings the file pattern `*.js`.

editors.name: Zed
editors.setup: needs a small Zed extension first ([PORTING.md](PORTING.md#zed-settingsjson))

page.title: Zed
steps: Zed only starts language servers that an extension provides, so it needs a small Zed extension first; [how, in PORTING.md]({repo}/blob/main/PORTING.md#zed-settingsjson).
